messages.subject: Re: Order L-28480 confirmed
messages.text:
Hi James,
 

 We are so, so sorry for the much longer than usual response time. Your email got stuck in our spam folder and it was your Messenger that got us to check it! We definitely have to check it more often
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and postal code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the ones you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable to your case, we will either ask you to pay a $9.99 exchange fee, or if not applicable, we will ship your new products for free! 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay

 Hi James,
 

 We are so, so sorry for the much longer than usual response time. Your email got stuck in our spam folder and it was your Messenger that got us to check it! We definitely have to check it more often
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and postal code, select the products you wish to return and then choose the ones you want as replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack the products to be returned, and affix the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable to your case, we will either ask you to pay a $9.99 exchange fee, or if not applicable, we will ship your new products for free! 😊
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Gabriel 
 Co-founder 
 Lasclay
